type: W4 sewing machine electronic control box (LCD panel)

specs.display: LCD panel with icons (needle position, presser foot, trim, counter, soft start, needle stage, etc.)
specs.interface: Reset, presser foot chain, LED light/trim, speaker, + (increase), - (decrease), < (left), > (right), P (parameter/save/exit)
specs.factoryResetMethod: Press and hold the RESET button for 3 seconds
specs.parameterEntry: Press P button to enter parameter mode; press P to save; press P again to exit
specs.monitorShortcut: P + presser foot chain button together to enter monitoring mode
specs.trimCounterShortcut: P + (+) button together to enter trim counter mode; press > or < to switch between trim counter and stitch counter

note: W4-UT uses the same AHE59 controller as the K5-UT, with identical parameters and monitoring. Key differences: W4-UT adds Err-19 (turn-off switch warning) and Err-22 (cut line abnormality), and the safety switch alarm displays as 'ArN UP' (rockover switch warning) rather than K5-UT's 'Safety switch alarm'. P66=0 closes the safety switch detection.

errorCodes.cause: Hardware overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the machine and turn it on after 30 seconds. If the control box still does not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Software overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: Turn off the machine and turn it on after 30 seconds. If the control box still does not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: System under-voltage — supply voltage below 176V
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect power of control box. Check whether the power voltage is low (lower than 176V). If the power voltage is low, restart the control box when voltage gets it right. If still not work, please replace the control boxes and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Down time overvoltage — supply voltage above 264V while machine is off
errorCodes.solution: Disconnect power of control box. Check whether the power voltage is high (higher than 264V). If the power voltage is low, restart the control box when voltage gets it right. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform service center.

errorCodes.cause: Operation overvoltage — supply voltage too high during operation
errorCodes.solution: Restart after 30 seconds. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Magnet circuit fault — solenoid connection loose or broken
errorCodes.solution: Power off. Check the connection of magnet, whether loose or break. Replace it if loose or broken, then restart the system. If still not work, please replace the control boxes and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Current detection circuit fault
errorCodes.solution: Power off. Restart after 30 seconds, check whether it can work normally. Try again a few times. If the error occurs frequently, please replace the control boxes and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Motor locked rotor — motor plug loose or broken, foreign matter tangled in machine head
errorCodes.solution: Power off. Check whether the motor power plug has fallen off, is loose, or broken. Check whether any foreign matter is twisted in the machine head. Restart after check and repair. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Brake circuit breakdown — white braking resistor connector loose or disconnected
errorCodes.solution: Power off. Check the connection of the white resistance on the power panel — whether fallen off or loose. Restart after plugging in. If still not work, please replace the control boxes and inform service center.

errorCodes.cause: HMI communication error — control panel connection to controller loose or fallen off
errorCodes.solution: Check the connection of control panel and controller, whether loose or fallen off. Make it right and then restart it. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Machine head needle position signal breakdown — synchronizer connection loose
errorCodes.solution: Check the connection between machine head frame synchronization unit and controller. If loose, make it right then restart. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform service center.

errorCodes.cause: Motor initial angle detection error
errorCodes.solution: Power off, then try 2 to 3 times. If still reports error, please replace the control boxes and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Motor HALL breakdown — motor sensor plug loose or fallen off
errorCodes.solution: Power off. Check the motor sensor connector. If loose or fallen off, make it right then restart. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: DSP read EEPROM error
errorCodes.solution: Restart after 30 seconds. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Motor overspeed protection
errorCodes.solution: Restart after 30 seconds. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Motor contrarotation (reverse rotation detected)
errorCodes.solution: Restart after 30 seconds. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: HMI read EEPROM error
errorCodes.solution: Restart after 30 seconds. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Motor overdrive (motor overload)
errorCodes.solution: Restart after 30 seconds. If still not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

errorCodes.cause: Turn off switch warning — machine head turn-off/rockover switch activated
errorCodes.solution: Adjust the machine head. Make sure the recovery of the turn-off switch.
errorCodes.note: Err-19 is specific to W4-UT; not present in K5-UT

errorCodes.cause: Cut line abnormality — thread cutting detection triggered
errorCodes.solution: Re-thread the needle and press the RESET button, or it will resume after 30 seconds.
errorCodes.note: Err-22 is specific to W4-UT (same code in K6 but different solution — K6 disables via P18)

alarmCodes.description: Counter alarm — stitch or piece count has reached maximum set value
alarmCodes.solution: Press P to cancel alarm and recount.

alarmCodes.description: Trim counter alarm — trimming count has reached maximum set value
alarmCodes.solution: Press P to cancel alarm and recount.

alarmCodes.description: Outage alarm — machine was powered off unexpectedly or while still powered
alarmCodes.solution: Wait 30 seconds, then turn on the machine again.

alarmCodes.description: Rockover switch warning — machine head has been tilted or tilted back, activating the rockover safety switch
alarmCodes.solution: Adjust the machine head until it stops the warning. Ensure the machine head is in its normal operating position.

alarmCodes.description: Dormancy — machine has entered sleep mode after inactivity
alarmCodes.solution: Turn off the machine and turn it on after 30 seconds. If the control box still does not work, please replace the control box and inform the service center.

troubleshooting.symptom: Err-19 turn-off switch warning on W4-UT
checks: The machine head has been tilted or the turn-off safety switch has been activated
Return the machine head to its normal upright operating position
Check that the turn-off switch contacts are not damaged or stuck
Once the machine head is properly positioned, the alarm should clear automatically

troubleshooting.symptom: ArN UP rockover switch warning on W4-UT
checks: The machine head rockover position sensor has been triggered
Adjust and return the machine head to its normal position
Check that the machine head latch or lock is engaged properly
The warning should stop once the machine head is correctly positioned

troubleshooting.symptom: Err-22 cut line abnormality on W4-UT
checks: The thread cutting detection sensor has triggered a fault
Re-thread the needle properly
Press the RESET button to clear the error
If not pressing RESET, the machine will resume automatically after 30 seconds
Disconnect power from the control box
Check that supply voltage is at least 176V (W4-UT requires 220V ±20%)
Wait for voltage to stabilize, then restart
If voltage is normal but error persists, replace the control box

troubleshooting.symptom: Err-08 motor locked rotor on W4-UT
checks: Power off immediately
Check the motor power plug — ensure it is firmly connected
Check the machine head for any foreign objects, tangled thread, or material blockage
Try to rotate the hand wheel manually to check if the mechanism moves freely
After clearing the obstruction, restart and test at low speed
